links.outcome: External-site AUC and PPV after few-shot local adaptation of AKI-PM
links.effect: AKI-PM maintained generalizability across external sites after few-shot adaptation (AUC 0.92-0.96, PPV 0.69-0.74) versus internal validation (AUC 0.95, PPV 0.68).
links.quote: AKI-PM achieves high predictive performance in internal validation (area under curve 0.95, positive predictive value 0.68) and maintains robust generalizability across external sites after few-shot (area under curve 0.92-0.96, positive predictive value 0.69-0.74).

links.outcome: Nephrologist Likert ratings of AKI-RAM explanations on 200 cases from four hospitals
links.effect: Six nephrologists rated AKI-RAM 4.18-4.88 across eight dimensions, with ICC 0.680-0.803.
links.quote: In a clinical evaluation of 200 cases from four independent hospitals by six nephrologists, AKI-RAM receives high scores across eight dimensions (Likert scale: 4.18-4.88) with moderate to good inter-rater reliability (intraclass correlation coefficients: 0.680-0.803).

unlisted_practices: Two-model LLM framework separating prediction from risk attribution that distinguishes modifiable from non-modifiable factors

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an LLM-based prediction and risk attribution framework for AKI across multiple centers, including an expert evaluation by nephrologists of the generated explanations, but it benchmarks the newly built model framework rather than evaluating a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
